label: Bug-9
title: Graph traversal API has severe performance issues at higher depths
description:
The `/nodes/api/nodes/{node_type}/{label}/graph?depth=N` endpoint has exponential performance degradation as depth increases.

## Observed Performance (Feature-12 graph)

| Depth | Response Time | Size |
|-------|---------------|------|
| 1 | ~2 seconds | 1.7 kB |
| 2 | ~10 seconds | 2.1 kB |
| 3 | ~15 seconds | 3.6 kB |

## Impact
- Depth 3 takes 15 seconds which makes the UI appear frozen
- Users may click multiple times thinking it didn't work
- Poor user experience

## Possible Causes
1. No caching of intermediate traversals
2. Redundant node lookups during traversal
3. Inefficient graph walking algorithm
4. File I/O on every node access

## Suggested Fixes
1. Add in-memory caching for graph traversal
2. Batch load all nodes upfront before traversal
3. Use adjacency list pre-computed on startup
4. Add loading indicator with progress feedback
